content.short: Momentum is a comprehensive DeFi hub on Sui featuring a CLMM DEX, liquid staking, and ve(3,3) tokenomics.
content.description:
Momentum is an all-in-one decentralized finance hub and liquidity engine built natively on the Sui blockchain. Formerly known as MSafe, the platform features a highly efficient Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker (CLMM) exchange, providing users with professional-grade trading tools and minimal slippage. Momentum utilizes a sophisticated ve(3,3) tokenomics model, where users can lock MMT tokens for veMMT to participate in governance and receive 100% of protocol-generated fees.

Beyond its core exchange features, Momentum offers liquid staking through xSUI, allowing participants to earn network staking rewards while maintaining capital liquidity for use across the broader Sui DeFi ecosystem. The protocol focuses on maximizing capital efficiency and aligning long-term incentives for liquidity providers and traders. As a primary liquidity layer for Sui, Momentum is empowering users to build and manage complex decentralized portfolios within a single, unified interface.
